title: Teraslice Job
description: Configuration for a Teraslice job. Hand-written from packages/job-components/src/job-schemas.ts (jobSchema) and packages/types/src/teraslice.ts (ValidatedJobConfig, OpConfig, APIConfig).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema so editors pick it up without the extension/workspace config.

lifecycle.description: Job lifecycle behavior, determines if it should exit on completion or remain active.

active.description: A convenience marker indicating whether the job is in active use. Teraslice does not use it.

analytics.description: Logs the time it took in milliseconds for each action, as well as the number of docs it receives.

assets.description: An array of strings that are the IDs (or names) for the corresponding asset zip files.

autorecover.description: Automatically recover pending slices from the last stopped/completed execution.

max_retries.description: The number of times a worker will attempt to process the same slice after an error has occurred.

slicers.description: How many parallel slicer contexts that will run within the slicer.

workers.description: The number of workers dedicated for the job. Runtime default is min(cpuCount, 5).

probation_window.description: Time in ms (or a duration string) the execution controller checks for failed slices before marking the execution running. Only applies when lifecycle is 'persistent'.

stateful.description: Indicates that the Teraslice worker maintains internal state, and must be handled differently.

log_level.description: The log level to be set on all loggers associated with the job.

labels.description: Key/value pairs used to label kubernetes resources.

env_vars.description: Environment variables to set on each Teraslice worker, e.g. { "EXAMPLE": "test" }.

operations.description: An array of actions to execute: typically the first is a reader and the last is a sender, with any number of processors in-between.

apis.description: An array of apis to load and any configuration they require. Unlike operations, none are required.

targets.description: Kubernetes only: array of key/value labels used for targeting teraslice jobs to nodes.

cpu.description: DEPRECATED (kubernetes): number of cpus to reserve per teraslice worker. Use resources_requests_cpu instead.

cpu_execution_controller.description: Kubernetes only: number of cpus to reserve per teraslice execution controller.

ephemeral_storage.description: Kubernetes only: add an ephemeral storage volume to worker and execution controller pods.

external_ports.description: Kubernetes only: ports to expose as external ports on the pods. Each entry is a port number or { name, port }. Port 45680 is reserved by Teraslice.

memory.description: DEPRECATED (kubernetes): memory, in bytes, to reserve per teraslice worker. Use resources_requests_memory instead.

memory_execution_controller.description: Kubernetes only: memory, in bytes, to reserve per teraslice execution controller.

pod_spec_override.description: Kubernetes only: override the generated pod spec. Requires the master to set kubernetes_overrides_enabled: true.

resources_requests_cpu.description: Kubernetes only: CPU request, in cores, to set on Teraslice workers.

resources_requests_memory.description: Kubernetes only: memory request, in bytes, to set on Teraslice workers.

resources_limits_cpu.description: Kubernetes only: CPU limit, in cores, to set on Teraslice workers.

resources_limits_memory.description: Kubernetes only: memory limit, in bytes, to set on Teraslice workers.

volumes.description: Kubernetes only: array of volumes to be mounted by job workers.

kubernetes_image.description: Kubernetes only: custom image name for the job.

prom_metrics_enabled.description: Kubernetes only: create a prometheus exporter. Overrides the terafoundation value.

prom_metrics_port.description: Kubernetes only: port of the prometheus exporter server. Overrides the terafoundation value.

prom_metrics_add_default.description: Kubernetes only: display default node metrics in the prom client. Overrides the terafoundation value.

operation.description: A single operation (reader, processor, or sender). Operation-specific options depend on _op and are provided by the asset; they are not validated here.

_op.description: Name of the operation; must reflect the name of the file or folder providing it.

_api_name.description: The name of the API used by this operation (matches an entry in the top-level 'apis' array, optionally namespaced like 'example:0').

_connection.description: The name of the connection; should match one listed in your sysconfig terafoundation.connectors.

_encoding.description: Data encoding type used when calling DataEntity.fromBuffer.

_dead_letter_action.description: What to do when a record fails to parse/transform. Builtins: 'throw' (throw the original error), 'log' (log error + data), 'none' (skip). Any other value is treated as a registered Dead Letter Queue API name.

api.description: A single API or Observer loaded into the execution context. API-specific options depend on _name and are provided by the asset; they are not validated here.

_name.description: Required, unique API name. May be namespaced with ':<id>' (e.g. 'example:0'); text after ':' is stripped when locating the file/folder.

_encoding.description: Data encoding type used when calling DataEntity.fromBuffer.

_dead_letter_action.description: What to do when a record fails to parse/transform. Builtins: 'throw', 'log', 'none'. Any other value is treated as a registered Dead Letter Queue API name.
